cases.rationale: Stable exertional angina in a stented man: the episodes on Day -6, Day -3 and Day 0 match the pattern he describes as unchanged for a year, each eases with rest, and vitals stay flat at onset (watch HR 66 bpm, cuff 134/80). Under the banded chest-pain rule every vital is band D and there is no crescendo pattern or other red flag, so HT_CHEST_PAIN_VITALS is suppressed below the band threshold and logged for a nurse review of his angina plan, not escalated. Naive-model trap: paging a clinician for any chest tightness in a stent patient, or treating it as identical to the paired crescendo case; the frequency is unchanged, which is the decisive difference.
cases.decisive_feature: Exertional chest tightness at his usual, unchanged frequency (two or three hill episodes a week for a year, confirmed on the phone check), with watch HR 66 bpm at onset and no vital-sign change; the paired case is the same picture with a crescendo pattern.
